title: Skill file (one code edition)
description: Version 0.3.0 (2026-10-19): adds public_names and the record flag code_text (the bundle's WG files), and group_name is public in own-words files (x-public "own_words"). Version 0.2.0 (2026-10-19): adds distinct_from. Version 0.1.0 (2026-10-18), inferred from the Oct 2026 extractor outputs and ucg-code-of-points/catalog/ucg_skills.json. One file holds one code edition: the extractor outputs (WG MAG/WAG, Xcel, USAG Development, NAIGC) and the four authored UCG files (MAG, WAG, Masters MAG, Masters WAG). Field annotations: x-public says whether the field may go into the public planner bundle (true; false = Code text, private; "ucg" = public only for UCG codes, whose text UCG owns; "own_words" = public only in an own_words file). x-derived marks fields a build fills in, never edited by hand. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema the file was written against. Readers reject a different major.

code.description: Code edition key: the key the catalog uses in element.codes, or for a combined list (UCG-WAG-COMBINED) its own key.

edition.description: Human label of the edition, e.g. "2025-2028" or, for UCG, the last-updated date.

built.description: Date the content last changed. Writers keep the old date when a rerun gives the same content, so reruns stay byte-identical.

own_words.description: true when every description is an own-words short name, not Code text (the *_simplified files), so description is public even for an external code. Absent = false.

public_names.description: true when every description may be published although not all are own words: own-words names, plus the Code's own text where UCG chose it, each such record marked code_text (bundle/skills/wg-*.json, from Nate's name review 2026-10-18). Absent = false.

kind.description: extracted: from a PDF by an extractor. transcribed: from vision transcription (USAG Development). authored: hand-maintained (UCG). combined: built from other skill files (UCG WAG Skills).

document.description: Source document name (never the PDF itself).

commit.description: Commit of the content (not of HEAD at build time).

redirects.description: Retired record id -> the id that replaces it (a merge). UCG only; record ids never change otherwise.

retired.description: Record ids that were removed. Never reused.

recordId.description: Permanent record id, owned by the repo that authors the code (UCG: ucg-code-of-points/catalog/ids.json). Not the catalog element id (MAG-FX-0001), which gym-skill-extract owns.

value.description: Difficulty as the code prints it: WG/NAIGC "A=0.1"; USAG/UCG bare letter; UCG also Sub-A, ME, GE, Misc; vaults a number string ("2.2"). null = no value printed (USAG vaults, NAIGC blanks).

id.description: Required for authored (UCG) records. Extractor records get their planner id (rid) from skill_catalog/sources.py instead.

number.description: Element number as printed, always a string ("1", "1.101", "Bronze 1"). WG MAG numbers restart in each element group.

variant.description: Paragraph within a numbered cell (USAG/WG WAG). Absent means 1.

description.description: Full skill text. Code text for external codes (private); UCG's own words for UCG codes. UCG's old field name was `name`.

eponym.description: "" when none. Several names joined with "/".

element_group.description: As printed: roman (WG MAG, UCG MAG), digits (WG WAG, USAG, UCG WAG), or a level/division label ("Bronze", "Level 6/7"). null where the code has none (Sub-A, vaults).

group_name.description: Element group heading. Code text in the extractor outputs; the generic headings ("Mounts", "Turns") in own-words files.

note.description: Skill note printed in the box. Code text for external codes.

markers.description: Printed marks: WG WAG * and D; USAG D, NA, Not Acro, FA, BKA, SA.

divisions.description: Xcel divisions the record is listed for.

start_values.description: Vault start value by division or level.

revised.description: Value or text revised in this edition (USAG).

source.description: Combined lists only (UCG WAG Skills): which code a record came from.

forms.description: Separately credited forms of one printed record (UCG rulings).

ucg_note.description: Why a UCG ruling changed or added this record.

code_text.description: true when description is the Code's own text (whitespace collapsed, trailing period dropped), published by UCG's choice; only in a public_names file. Absent = own words.

distinct_from.description: UCG: records in another UCG code that look like this one but were decided to be different skills (never paired, e.g. by Masters sync).

box.description: UCG: the SVG <a> id of the box that draws this record (geometry and drawing stay in the SVG).

drawing.description: UCG: the box has a drawing. Derived from the SVG.

page.description: UCG Masters: page in the built PDF.

main_id.description: UCG Masters: id of the main-code record this Masters box copies (replaces Masters/sync.json keys).

adopted.description: UCG: date an older box was taken into the authored file.

removed.description: UCG: date removed (record kept so the id stays retired).

tags.description: Skill facts for the planner's SR and restriction detection (skill_catalog/tags/TAG_SPEC.md). Xcel/Development UB, BB, FX.
